description: A7 replay: the payer of KIK-1040 sends the same 'never arrived' email twice, a few minutes apart, as two separate tickets. Expected deny on both: the carrier shows KIK-1040 in transit, so a not-received claim matches no rule. The message is simulated. Illustrative people and orders.
